# Death This guide will explain death in Persistence and what you can do about it.
Characters in Persistence are typically recoverable and so a dead character usually has two options:
## Death SOS Using the "Death Network" action you can open a menu where you can emit a death SOS. This broadcasts a radio globally which contains the coordinates of your body.
Typically you can be swiftly recovered by a medical department and revived even after a prolonged period of rotting.
## Accept Death Using the "Death Network" action you can open a menu where you can accept death. A character that accepts death will be permanently killed and cannot be recreated.
You will be returned to the lobby to create a new character.
